title: Trailing Zeros of a Range
statement:
For each query `l r`, multiply all integers from `l` to `r` inclusive and count how many zeros the product ends with in decimal. Print one answer per query, one per line.

## Input
The first line contains `q`. Each of the next `q` lines contains `l` and `r`.

## Output
Print `q` lines, the answer to each query.

## Constraints
- `1 <= q <= 4500`
- `1 <= l <= r <= 10^18`
